Nimbus Labs designs Nimbus Ledger Sync for alignment with India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023, but this is a design goal and not a certification or a compliance statement.
Passwords must be at least 14 characters. Administrator accounts must use hardware security keys in addition to passwords, and shared accounts are not permitted.
